summary: Describes how the restrictions on the IPv6 flow label apply when it is used for load balancing by equal cost multipath routing and link aggregation. It focuses on IP-in-IPv6 tunnels, where the outer header can carry a label for spreading traffic across paths.

eli5.summary: When many roads lead to the same place, cars can be spread out. The flow label helps keep one trip on one road. This explains using it for tunneled traffic.
